title: Reading promise exceeds available content
page_component: Publications / PublicationPreview / desktop1363 and390; default + TE11 related works
viewport_state: Publications / PublicationPreview / desktop1363 and390; default + TE11 related works
observed_problem: Buka artikel leads to metadata/editorial context with the full manuscript withheld. TE11 related works use large equivalent entries for articles, planning context and a documentary reference whose original is unavailable. Catalogue introduction explains limitations, but individual destination promises remain ambiguous.
user_impact: A reader seeking knowledge can follow several attractive links without finding a readable work. This is a discovery/expectation issue, not authorization to release originals.
proposed_correction: Derive a short visible availability label from the existing availability contract at preview and related-link level; label metadata-only destinations Lihat catatan karya. Reserve Baca artikel for an actually readable approved body. Preserve independent work identities and all canonical links.
expected_benefit: Visitors know what they will receive before navigating.
regression_tradeoff: Do not collapse editorial readiness, source verification and original availability into a single badge; avoid status clutter.
owner_approval: Step6B approval for shared labels/presentation; full-manuscript clearance remains separate.
success_criteria: Every restricted/metadata-only preview identifies that state before click; available-body and metadata-only synthetic fixtures get different truthful actions; TE11/article return still works.

title: Audit language competes with the public story
page_component: Homepage ActivitySelection and GH/RC/BATAFIA detail; desktop1363/390
viewport_state: Homepage ActivitySelection and GH/RC/BATAFIA detail; desktop1363/390
observed_problem: Home activity summaries foreground LPJ status, route-length revisions and unresolved forum dates. GH regency uncertainty receives a large callout before its learning narrative. Documentary prose repeatedly says what a photo or report does not prove. All may be accurate, but their hierarchy emphasizes the research process.
user_impact: Unfamiliar visitors receive limitations before understanding the activity or why it matters; the institution can read like an unfinished evidence audit.
proposed_correction: Keep material uncertainty visibly concise beside the relevant fact. Move methodological detail to existing evidence disclosure. Use a short visitor-facing purpose/context summary for each preview, preserving underlying sourced facts and source access.
expected_benefit: A readable institutional story with accountable evidence rather than administrative prose as the main voice.
regression_tradeoff: Do not hide contested facts, invent outcomes or change canonical assertions. Copy review is needed; blanket removal of cautions would be wrong.
owner_approval: Owner editorial approval of proposed copy and Step6B implementation.
success_criteria: Homepage summaries explain activity/context in1–2 sentences; significant date/location conflicts stay visible; complete original caveats remain one disclosure away; no factual or rights change.

title: Expanded catalogues need a declared ordering and shorter scan units
observed_problem: PD first rows jump from2023 to2025, then back to2023/2024. Full programme titles, long report-oriented summaries and12px dates make many entries look alike. Four-column text is crowded, but measured bounds are separate: no overlap or horizontal-overflow failure was confirmed.
user_impact: A member/alumnus must read repeated words and infer list order to locate a precedent.
proposed_correction: Choose a documented default order (recommend documented date descending, unknown dates separate; alternatively explicit division/cohort groups). Within PD shorten display titles to field+cohort while preserving full detail identity/accessibility. Keep place and concise summary together; increase date prominence using existing text roles.
expected_benefit: Faster comparison without removing sparse records or imposing cohort as universal parent.
regression_tradeoff: Sorting by uncertain dates must use canonical precision; do not invent dates or imply recency coverage. Avoid a new filter engine.
owner_approval: Owner chooses ordering; Step6B approves shared row refinements.
success_criteria: 18PD records remain discoverable; order is explained and deterministic; long-title fixtures wrap at320/390/768/1024/1366; no cell collision, loss of canonical name, empty narrative or broken filter return.

title: Important field subjects are small in mobile photo pair
observed_problem: At390 frame width, GH renders about136×242CSSpx and RC about182×242. Full frames preserve map and ground team, but individual climbers are tiny; long adjacent captions consume substantial vertical space. Detail RC is300×400 on desktop, more legible but still not a close study.
user_impact: Authentic education risks becoming atmospheric illustration rather than an immediately legible action.
proposed_correction: Keep full framing and credit. Prototype a keyboard-accessible enlarge-current-image view using the already approved derivative, or a bounded stacked-mobile treatment; compare actual subject visibility and page length before choosing.
expected_benefit: The actual map practice and teamwork become inspectable without factual image edits.
regression_tradeoff: Stacking greatly increases page length; cropping could remove the ground team. A viewer adds focus/close/return semantics and may require use confirmation.
owner_approval: Owner approves viewing treatment and confirms exact contextual permission before any enlargement/crop/new placement; no new asset presumed cleared.
success_criteria: Subject is inspectable at390/320; exact credit remains adjacent; Escape/focus return/no scroll trap if viewer chosen; no unapproved use or new derivative; existing loading behavior preserved.

title: Jejak is chronological but too close to an activity digest
page_component: InstitutionalHistory /1363 and390; full text and first screen
viewport_state: InstitutionalHistory /1363 and390; full text and first screen
observed_problem: Eight selected milestones are responsibly sourced and gaps are stated. Most recent entries summarize activities/works; repeated per-entry disclosures and similar row anatomy make institutional change and knowledge transmission less salient.1995→2022 is a genuine large evidence gap.
user_impact: An alumnus can trace events, but may not understand the institutional continuity connecting them.
proposed_correction: Add concise sourced thematic framing around existing entries (formation; documented education and accumulated work), and distinguish institutional milestones from activity examples visually. Keep all entries, their dates, links and gap statement.
expected_benefit: History reads as institutional interpretation supported by activities, not a second activity index.
regression_tradeoff: Do not invent intermediate periods, leadership changes, annual continuity or ceremony details; insufficient evidence remains a content responsibility.
owner_approval: Owner approves editorial framing; additional historical claims need separate evidence.
success_criteria: A newcomer can distinguish founding/history from activity chronology; gap remains explicit; sourced links/anchor focus/order and unknown-date grouping survive.

title: Footer Kegiatan link unexpectedly narrows to TE
page_component: InstitutionalFooter / all public pages; desktop and390
viewport_state: InstitutionalFooter / all public pages; desktop and390
observed_problem: The generic footer label Kegiatan links to #/program/te. Clicking it from PD opens Tursina Explore, while the main general activity destination is #/activities.
user_impact: A visitor using the footer loses the broader activities context and can reasonably assume other activities are absent.
proposed_correction: Either route generic Kegiatan to the general catalogue or relabel it Tursina Explore and expose the broader route clearly.
regression_tradeoff: Preserve direct TE access and programme-first discovery; this is a link-label correction, not a new IA.
owner_approval: Step6B approval; no architectural decision needed.
success_criteria: Footer label matches destination at every route and viewport; keyboard activation opens the expected h1.

title: Related-record links lack useful grouping and concise explanations
observed_problem: Role labels are accurate but repeated; Catatan yang terhubung / Telusuri hubungan catatan describes the registry rather than a reader goal. Four work entries plus history use similar large hierarchy. Long titles and availability caveats make this section a substantial second catalogue.
user_impact: Visitors must decode relationship language and scan several equally emphasized destinations after an already long story.
proposed_correction: Group by meaningful reader purpose: Karya terkait, Kegiatan terkait, Dalam Jejak Tursina. Use concise human role descriptions and contextual availability cues. Keep every valid edge reachable; distinguish shared departure from same activity and standards from achievement.
expected_benefit: Retains reciprocal discovery while reducing cognitive and vertical load.
regression_tradeoff: Do not replace sourced relations with unsourced recommendations or discard additional activities from a multi-linked work.
success_criteria: Multi-activity and withdrawal fixtures pass; all valid related targets remain reachable; related section scans by content type/purpose rather than repeated graph labels; no fake parent.

title: Jejak homepage fallback repeats itself instead of adding context
observed_problem: The text-only Jejak plate repeats kebersamaan/kegiatan/pendidikan/tradisi already in the adjacent preview, then displays a photo-permission message. The missing photograph is correctly withheld but the replacement does little independent communication.
user_impact: The homepage ends with an internal editorial condition and redundant copy rather than a clear institutional-history reason to continue.
proposed_correction: Replace duplicate fallback prose with a compact sourced founding/context treatment and one explicit history action; omit optional media-panel structure when no cleared image exists.
expected_benefit: Stronger closing rhythm without adding a photograph or claiming complete history.
regression_tradeoff: Avoid increasing founding-date repetition across sections; no requirement to clear asset14 just to fill a panel.
owner_approval: Step6B composition/copy approval within existing section sequence.
success_criteria: No HOLD image; no large empty panel; Jejak purpose and date remain understandable; mobile section is shorter and has one clear next step.

title: Programme explanation precedes a lengthy route to filters
observed_problem: The first filter begins about2169CSSpx down the390 document; catalogue height is8362px. The existing Lihat catatan kegiatan shortcut correctly jumps to results and preserves educational explanations.
user_impact: A returning member who misses the text shortcut scrolls through five field descriptions before finding the record tool.
proposed_correction: Preserve introduction/fields and make the existing jump action more scannable, with a compact catalogue/field switch anchor near the page title. Do not duplicate all filters or add sticky UI by default.
expected_benefit: First-time education and repeat retrieval can coexist.
regression_tradeoff: Not a blocked journey: shortcut already works. Sticky controls could consume scarce mobile height.
success_criteria: Results reachable in one obvious action from first screen; reset/status/focus and combined facets stay correct; all five field explanations remain available.

title: Opening communicates fellowship better than field practice
observed_problem: Kawi group image authentically shows collective and campus context; ceiling occupies much of its upper area. The first-screen explanation carries outdoor purpose, while the strongest action photographs arrive later. This is not proof that the approved hero is ineffective.
user_impact: Possible opportunity for a more immediate link between the collective and what members learn.
proposed_correction: Keep current opening as baseline. Compare one private, bounded alternate image treatment using existing authentic material and the same copy/actions; judge people visibility, purpose and mobile fold. Prefer a small contextual education cue before an untested hero swap.
expected_benefit: An evidence-based decision about identity emphasis.
regression_tradeoff: TE11 hero could over-identify the institution with one expedition; GH portrait cannot simply fill a landscape slot. New placement/crop approval may be required even for an already cleared asset.
owner_approval: Separate owner choice to test an alternate opening/use; no automatic replacement.
success_criteria: Both options preserve identity/affiliation/purpose/actions before oversized media; owner compares at1366/390/320; no participant preference claimed without testing.

title: Homepage transitions can be slightly tighter
observed_problem: Open programme rows, a photographic feature, green education band and dated ledger are meaningfully different. Some repeated large title/deck/section gaps lengthen an already6735px mobile page, but length alone does not establish poor usability.
user_impact: Potentially slower traversal to publications/history; early programme links already mitigate this.
proposed_correction: After higher-impact changes, test a modest reduction of redundant internal gaps using existing spacing steps, not a new layout language.
expected_benefit: More intentional pacing without losing editorial calm.
regression_tradeoff: Over-compression harms reading and field-media emphasis. Avoid a global spacing reduction before inspecting all pages.
owner_approval: Owner preference after targeted comparison, not a launch blocker.
success_criteria: Section sequence and distinct grammar remain; no clipped text; first-screen clarity unchanged; compare full pages rather than just reduced pixel height.

title: Institutional continuity has no verified current-facing layer yet
observed_problem: Historical content is explicitly labelled. There is no verified2026 current activity, recruitment path or public institutional contact in the approved dataset. This is a content/authority gap, not a missing backend or licence to invent a current feed.
user_impact: Prospective participants learn what Tursina does but cannot use this prototype to establish current participation arrangements.
proposed_correction: Keep archive wording honest. Ask the owner later for one verified current institutional orientation/contact or approved current notice, through normal editorial review. No broad archive project or fabricated recruitment CTA.
expected_benefit: A future living-institution layer grounded in current facts.
regression_tradeoff: Requires current content authorization, maintenance ownership and freshness; outside read-only audit and not necessary to complete its frontend plan.
owner_approval: Separate item-specific content decision; no current details requested as a blocker to Step6B.
success_criteria: When supplied, current info has source/date/authority and explicit review responsibility; historical records remain historical.
